Step indicators/labels: locked step titles are plain divs with cursor:auto, clicking does nothing (KF-4)
Store row: Connect, Ready badge, location line, Disconnect
'+ Connect a/another Shopify store' inline form: empty submit error, duplicate error, Cancel
Location select for 2-location store: 'Location required' state, then Change to re-pick
Continue: disabled with helper 'Connect at least one store' / 'Choose a location for every store', then enabled 'Continue with N stores'
Per-integration 'Needs change' rows, numbered 4-step instructions, Open Settings, Check again (appears only after Open Settings)
Auto-match loading state 'Matching Shopify products with QuickBooks items…'
Per-store 'N of M products matched' rows + Match the rest
Duplicate-mapping warning (Pump → Stone 1, Stone 11) and 'Continue with N matched products'
Back to setup link with matched count, store select, Unmapped only, Search, Refresh
Per-row QuickBooks item select saving on change with toast, no hidden keystroke (KF-8), Remove
Explanation of why differences persist, difference table with row checkboxes, live count on bulk button
'Set Shopify to QuickBooks numbers (N)' confirm modal (Cancel/confirm), Skip, done summary '8 products updated in Shopify'
Explanation that changes made before turn-on are not sent; Turn on sync with 'Turning on and running the first check…' in-progress state

Change on a done step while a later step is current, and Continue returning to the later step
On/Paused chip, last-check line, Pause/Resume (no confirm), Run now (disabled while paused), Pending/Held/Failed/Applied counters
Attention lines: location needed, Non-inventory setting + Open Settings, unmatched products + Match products, differences + Compare stock, duplicate mapping + Mappings
Store rows, location Change, Disconnect, Connect another store while running
'Setup · 5 of 5 done' summary + Review steps accordion
Event table, View in Shopify (no target), Revert + confirm modal with warning

Empty states: Mappings 'Connect a Shopify store first.', Events 'No sync events. Events appear after you turn on sync.', Compare stock 'No comparisons yet. Run one with Compare now.'
Loading states: auto-match in step 3, turn-on in step 5
Error/validation states: store domain empty/duplicate, location required, Continue disabled
Paused state of running card
Second-place behaviour: Open Settings in step 2 (followed by Check again) vs Open Settings in running attention line (no Check again)
Second-place behaviour: setup progress shown as 'Setup · 5 of 5 done' vs 'Step 2 of 5 · 4 done' in expanded Review steps
Second-place behaviour: Ignore in Compare stock before vs after Compare now

findings.element: Running view: 'Setup · 5 of 5 done' summary / Review steps, and attention line 'third-shop (Shopify) creates Non-inventory items · Open Settings'
findings.finding: After a store is added while running, the collapsed summary still says 'Setup · 5 of 5 done' while the expanded setup shows step 2 re-opened at 4 done, and the attention line only offers Open Settings with no Check again.
findings.user_impact: The user is told setup is complete when a required step is not, and after fixing the setting in Settings they have no visible way to confirm it, so the new store's products keep being created as Non-inventory without them noticing (KF-2 pattern: UI implies the job is done).
findings.suggested_fix: Make the collapsed summary reflect the reopened step (e.g. 'Setup · 4 of 5 done · Step 2 needs attention') and add Check again next to Open Settings on the attention line.

evidence.action: In running view, Connect another Shopify store (third-shop) and pick a location, then click Open Settings on the attention line, then click Review steps
evidence.observed: Attention line reads 'third-shop (Shopify) creates Non-inventory items · Open Settings'; clicking it only toasts 'Settings opened in a new tab.' and the state map records 'no Check again offered in running view'; the collapsed card still reads 'Setup · 5 of 5 done' while expanded Review steps shows 'Step 2 of 5 · 4 done' with step 2 open

findings.element: Compare stock tab empty state during setup
findings.finding: The empty state tells the user to 'Run one with Compare now.' but no Compare now button exists on the screen until sync has been turned on.
findings.user_impact: A user who opens Compare stock during setup to check stock differences hits a dead end: the instruction points to a control that isn't there and nothing says the tab only works after setup.
findings.suggested_fix: While setup is not finished, replace the text with 'Comparisons are available after you turn on sync — differences for setup are shown in step 4.' and link back to setup.

evidence.action: Open the prototype (1 · First setup) and click the Compare stock tab, at step 1 and again after reaching step 3
evidence.observed: The tab shows only 'No comparisons yet. Run one with Compare now.' and the only visible buttons are the variant switcher and the four tabs; Compare now appears only after Turn on sync

findings.element: Compare stock tab: row action Ignore
findings.finding: Ignore marks a row 'Ignored', but the next Compare now silently resets it to 'Unresolved', and ignored products still count in the attention line's 'N products differ'.
findings.user_impact: Users who deliberately dismissed a difference see it return on every comparison and in the running card's count, so they either keep re-ignoring it or stop trusting what 'Ignore' did.
findings.suggested_fix: Either persist Ignored across comparisons and exclude it from the attention count, or rename the action to make clear it only applies to this comparison (e.g. 'Ignore this time').

evidence.action: In 2 · Sync running, Compare stock tab: click Ignore on Stone 13 and Set Shopify to QuickBooks on Stone 12, then click Compare now and return to Overview
evidence.observed: Stone 13 first showed 'Ignored'; after Compare now it read 'Stone 13 Appollo -22 100 -122 Unresolved Set Shopify to QuickBooks Ignore'; the Overview attention line only dropped from 5 to '4 products differ from QuickBooks'

findings.element: Step 2 'Track inventory in QuickBooks': Check again button
findings.finding: Check again is not rendered until the user clicks Open Settings, so a user who changes the setting by another route (already-open Settings tab or the sidebar Settings link) has no way to advance step 2.
findings.user_impact: A user who follows 'Click Update, then come back here' but didn't use this page's Open Settings button returns to a locked step with no visible way forward, blocking the rest of the strictly ordered setup.
findings.suggested_fix: Show Check again in step 2 from the start, next to Open Settings.

evidence.action: Open step 2 (after Continue with 2 stores) and look for Check again before clicking Open Settings
evidence.observed: State map records 'Check again (before Open Settings): present=false'; it appears only after Open Settings is clicked (toast 'Settings opened in a new tab.')

gaps: Step 4 Skip was never clicked, so what happens to step 4's summary, the running view and the differences after skipping is unknown
Check again always succeeds; the 'setting still not changed' branch of step 2 is not built, so the error/retry state for step 2 cannot be judged
Review steps in running view: expanded step 2 text is truncated in the state map, so whether Check again is offered there is unconfirmed
Disconnect of the last/only store while sync is running not exercised; whether it is confirmed and what the running card shows afterwards is unknown
Held and Failed events never occurred (counters stayed at 0), so running-view and Events-tab error states were not observed
Open Settings and View in Shopify have no real target in the prototype, so the return trip from Settings back to this page cannot be judged
